movie.mainStoryPrompt: Silent Minecraft adventure. Alex rides a camel across a bright desert and discovers a desert temple. Inside, she notices the central pressure plate before stepping on it. She safely places blocks around the trap, reaches the treasure room, finds a golden apple and a map, then climbs out as a sandstorm begins in the distance. She returns to her camel and rides toward a savanna village. No dialogue, no narration, no explosion, no horror.
movie.storySummary: Alex ขี่อูฐผ่านทะเลทรายและพบ Desert Temple เธอสังเกตกับดัก pressure plate ก่อนเหยียบ จึงวางบล็อกสร้างทางปลอดภัยลงไปยังห้องสมบัติ พบ golden apple และแผนที่ แล้วกลับขึ้นมาขี่อูฐออกจากทะเลทรายอย่างปลอดภัย

scenes.title: Across the Desert
scenes.description: Alex rides a camel across a bright desert biome.
scenes.location: ทะเลทราย (Desert Biome)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ขี่อูฐไปตามเนินทรายใต้ท้องฟ้าสดใส
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Alex riding a tan Minecraft camel across bright sand dunes, cactus and blue sky, vertical cinematic framing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide side tracking shot following the camel over dunes. Audio: light desert wind, camel steps, upbeat adventure music. No speech.

scenes.title: Temple Ahead
scenes.description: Alex spots a desert temple in the distance.
scenes.location: ทะเลทราย (Desert Biome)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex หยุดอูฐบนเนินและมองเห็น Desert Temple อยู่ไกลออกไป
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft desert temple with orange terracotta pattern visible beyond dunes, Alex and camel on a ridge in foreground, bright daylight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push past Alex toward the distant temple. Audio: discovery chime, wind, music opens wider. No speech.

scenes.title: Inside the Temple
scenes.description: Alex enters the sandstone temple and approaches the central shaft.
scenes.actionDescription: Alex เดินเข้าไปในโถง sandstone และหยุดที่ลวดลายกลางพื้น
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft desert temple interior, Alex near the central orange-blue terracotta floor pattern, sunlight entering from doorway.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward dolly behind Alex toward the center pattern. Audio: soft footsteps, temple room tone, gentle mystery music. No speech.

scenes.title: The Pressure Plate
scenes.description: Alex notices the pressure plate below before stepping onto it.
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ชะโงกลงช่องกลางและเห็น stone pressure plate อยู่ด้านล่าง
scenes.imageDescription: Over-the-shoulder Minecraft shot of Alex looking down the temple shaft at a clearly visible stone pressure plate in the treasure room, no explosion.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow tilt down from Alex to the pressure plate. Audio: music pauses, faint caution chime. No speech.

scenes.title: Build Around It
scenes.description: Alex places blocks to make a safe route beside the trap.
scenes.actionDescription: Alex วางบล็อก sandstone เป็นขั้นลงข้างผนังโดยไม่แตะ pressure plate
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Alex placing sandstone blocks as a safe staircase down the temple shaft, pressure plate visible but untouched.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking shot following three sandstone block placements downward. Audio: block placement clicks, light puzzle music. No speech.

scenes.title: Treasure Room
scenes.description: Alex reaches the treasure room and opens one chest.
scenes.location: ห้องสมบัติ (Temple Treasure Room)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex เปิดหีบหนึ่งใบที่มุมห้องสมบัติ
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft desert temple treasure room, Alex opening one chest while carefully standing away from the central pressure plate, sandstone walls and four chests.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium shot as Alex opens one chest. Audio: chest creak, bright treasure chime, music lifts. No speech.

scenes.title: Golden Apple and Map
scenes.description: Alex finds a golden apple and map inside.
scenes.location: ห้องสมบัติ (Temple Treasure Room)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex หยิบ golden apple และแผนที่ออกจากหีบ
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Alex holding a golden apple in one hand and map in the other beside an open temple chest, bright warm torchlight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close push-in on the golden apple and map in Alex's hands. Audio: item pickup sounds, warm musical reward. No speech.

scenes.title: Back to Daylight
scenes.description: Alex climbs the safe block staircase back to the entrance.
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ปีนขั้น sandstone กลับขึ้นสู่โถงด้านบน
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Alex climbing the safe sandstone staircase inside the temple shaft toward bright sunlight above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Upward tracking shot following Alex climbing toward the light. Audio: footsteps, airy music, distant wind. No speech.

scenes.title: Camel Waiting
scenes.description: Alex exits and finds the camel waiting beside the temple.
scenes.location: ทะเลทราย (Desert Biome)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex เดินออกจากวิหารและอูฐลุกขึ้นรอเธออยู่ด้านนอก
scenes.imageDescription: Bright Minecraft desert temple exterior, Alex emerging with map while a tan camel waits beside sandstone steps, soft distant sand haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle pan from the temple doorway to the waiting camel. Audio: camel sound, wind, cheerful return theme. No speech.

scenes.title: Toward the Savanna
scenes.description: Alex rides away toward a distant savanna village.
scenes.location: ชายทะเลทรายสู่สะวันนา (Desert-Savanna Edge)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ขี่อูฐออกจากทะเลทรายตามทิศในแผนที่ มุ่งสู่หมู่บ้านสะวันนาไกล ๆ
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Alex riding camel from golden desert toward acacia savanna with a small village in distance, warm late-afternoon light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide rear tracking shot as camel travels toward the savanna. Audio: uplifting music resolution, camel steps, wind. Fade out. No speech.
